pilot.mapping_policy: pilot_lesson_map links introductory or repeated topic subsets only. A pilot session does not complete the linked full lessons, satisfy all their prerequisites, or award their outcomes automatically. Pilot sessions have their own prerequisite chain; P09 and P10 do not require completion of M04 or M05. Any required concept must be introduced inside the pilot before assessment.
